sources.snippet: Overview siglip2-so400m-patch14-384 is a vision-language encoder developed by google that performs zero-shot image classification, image-text retrieval, and serves as a vision backbone for larger vision-language models. Built on the SigLIP 2 architecture, this model extends the original SigLIP pretraining objective with three key innovations: decoder loss, global-local and masked prediction ...
